title: Functorial Roos augmentation and split mapping-cone sequence
statement: For l prime, E a finite extension of Q_l and X a scheme, the specified strict Roos construction is an additive functor on cochain complexes of internal O_E,X-modules and its augmentation is natural. It preserves degreewise split short exact sequences. For a chain map f:P to B, if the localized Roos augmentations of B and P[1] are isomorphisms, then the localized augmentation of cone(f) is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply a chain map to each tensor reduction and then to the product. Naturality of quotient transition maps shows that this product map commutes with one-minus-shift. The diagonal map on the two Roos coordinates is therefore a chain map, functorial and additive. Tensor-unit naturality gives the augmentation natural transformation.

Evaluation identifies each degree of the product with the product of the corresponding coefficient tensors. Apply the tensor and product maps to the two splitting operators of a degreewise split short exact sequence, diagonally in the two Roos coordinates. Additivity and functoriality prove the splitting identities, so both sequences are short exact.

The natural augmentation gives a morphism between the derived triangles of the two short exact sequences. The two-isomorphism criterion gives invertibility on the middle object. Apply this to B to cone(f) to P[1], with splitting operators the second projection and negative first inclusion of the cone.

lean.statement:
theorem roos_augmentation_cone {P P' : CochainComplex (Modules l E X) ℤ}
    (f : P ⟶ P')
    (hB : IsIso ((DerivedCategory.Q (C := Modules l E X)).map (augmentation l E X P')))
    (hA : IsIso ((DerivedCategory.Q (C := Modules l E X)).map (augmentation l E X (P⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)))) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.Q (C := Modules l E X)).map
      (augmentation l E X (CochainComplex.mappingCone f)))
